content.prompt: Felicity spent 20% of her savings on a bicycle and 15% of the remainder on a book. What percentage of her savings did she have left?

answer.short:
$68\%$

The book costs 15% of the remaining 80%, which is 12% of her original savings.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage remaining after bicycle}&=100\%-20\%\\\text{Percentage remaining after bicycle}&=80\%\\\text{Book as percentage of original savings}&=\frac{15}{100}\times80\%\\\text{Book as percentage of original savings}&=12\%\\\text{Percentage left}&=80\%-12\%\\\text{Percentage left}&=68\%\end{align*}$$
